name: launcher-command-coverage
title: The launcher's command table must cover the commands the CLI implements
description: bin/dove-pi.cjs routes a command to the Python CLI only if it is listed in pythonCommands; axi-turn is implemented in src/cli.ts and documented in dove_pi.py but missing from that list, so the documented command starts a Pi session instead. Cover the table with a check derived from the CLI's own command set.
creator: aixi
